svg.title: Workplace mode: live board, clarifying questions and minutes (types.rs, workplace.rs)

g.text: Workplace mode: live board, clarifying questions and minutes (types.rs, workplace.rs)
Pure functions used by the tracker and the minutes:
Fed from FINAL segments only, in workplace mode only.
Decisions: claims of kind decision (not repeated, lexical
similarity under 0.85). Action items: merged with an earlier
one when they restate it, or fill a missing owner or due date.
Questions: resolved (answered) or deferred by a later reply.
The board is replaced as a whole in each update event.
due is kept as said ("by Friday"),
never resolved to a calendar date.
Built by the minutes prompt (LLM, JSON output) or
The follow-up message is a draft for the user to copy.
Shown as the Clarify section of the board.
Clarifying questions are suggestions, not required steps.
